trickyParts: Ordering: React runs child layout effects before the parent's in one commit, so the hook's first placement (child) runs before IssuePage's [activeTab] restore (parent); the callback deletes the stale record in between, so the restore finds nothing to apply.
Chosen over relying on sibling effect order (moving the restore into a component rendered before the panels): the callback states the contract instead of depending on tree position.
